list.title: Trouble in the Fields
list.hook: Oh, thank goodness. You've got a sword, haven't you?
list.ask: They've been coming down to the fields after dark. I've not slept in a week. Get rid of {n} {target} for me?
list.thanks: I'll sleep tonight. Bless you.

list.title: Short a Patrol
list.hook: You. You look like you can use that.
list.ask: We're two patrols short and I've {n} {target} too close to the road. Clear them and I'll see you're paid.
list.thanks: Good work. I never saw you, and neither did the paperwork.

list.title: A Small Grudge
list.hook: Could I trouble you? It's a little embarrassing.
list.ask: One of them chased me clean up a tree last week, in front of everybody. Kill {n} {target}. Any of them. It's the principle.
list.thanks: That's better. I feel taller.

list.title: For Biscuit
list.hook: Are you a real adventurer?
list.ask: The monsters scared my dog and she ran off. She came back, but I'm still cross. Can you beat up {n} {target}? I've saved up.
list.thanks: You're the best! I'm telling everyone!

list.title: A Matter of Study
list.hook: Ah, an adventurer. Perfect timing.
list.ask: I'm writing on how they behave when they're cornered. For that I need a few fewer of them. Say, {n} {target}.
list.thanks: Fascinating. I shan't ask what it was like. Actually, I shall, but later.

list.title: Short on Flour
list.hook: You wouldn't happen to be heading past any farms?
list.ask: The mill's run dry and I've orders to fill. If you could find me {n} {target}, I'd pay above the market.
list.thanks: You've saved my morning. Here, and take a loaf.

list.title: A Rushed Order
list.hook: Have you a moment? And a strong back?
list.ask: A buyer wants a shipment by the week's end and I'm short {n} {target}. Find them and we'll both do well.
list.thanks: Just in time. A pleasure, as always.

list.title: Iron for the Forge
list.hook: You've the look of someone who goes where the ore is.
list.ask: Orders stacked to the rafters, and my iron's gone. {n} {target} would see me through the month.
list.thanks: That's good iron. You've an eye.

list.title: A Sweet Tooth
list.hook: Oh! Perfect. You look like you get about.
list.ask: We're out of the good stuff and the regulars are getting ideas. Bring me {n} {target} and the next one's on me.
list.thanks: You're a lifesaver. Don't tell the cook.

list.title: Bandages for the Shrine
list.hook: Forgive me, might I ask you something?
list.ask: We go through linen faster than the faithful bring it. {n} {target} would mean a great deal to the sick.
list.thanks: May the road be kind to you.

list.title: Flowers for Gran
list.hook: Hey! Hey, you! Are you busy?
list.ask: It's my gran's birthday and I'm not allowed past the wall. Can you get me {n} {target}? They're her favourite!
list.thanks: She's going to cry! The good kind!

list.title: A Letter to Anvilgate
list.hook: I don't suppose you're travelling north?
list.ask: My brother-in-law works the Hold. He doesn't write, so I must. Would you take this to any dwarf at Anvilgate? They'll pass it on, and pay you for the trouble. They always do.
list.thanks: From who? Hah! Here, for your boots.

list.title: Sealed Orders
list.hook: You there. Reliable, are you?
list.ask: This goes to any smith, sealed. Don't open it, don't ask. They'll pay on delivery.
list.thanks: About time. Here's your coin. Off you go.

list.title: A Query for the Elves
list.hook: Do you ever go near Lumenhollow?
list.ask: I've been asking the same elf the same question for eleven years. Please take this letter to anyone at the Tree.
list.thanks: Ah. Tell them we'll reply in a decade or so. For your trouble.

list.title: Things in the Shafts
list.hook: You. Tall one. Can you swing that thing?
list.ask: Lost a whole level to them last week. {n} {target}, gone, and the crew'll go back down. I'll stand you a drink as well.
list.thanks: Hah! Not bad for someone with their head in the weather.

list.title: Clearing the Pass
list.hook: Hold on. You've got the arms for it.
list.ask: The pass is thick with them and the mules won't go near. See off {n} {target}. We pay in good iron.
list.thanks: Well struck. Here, this is honest metal.

list.title: Coal for the Deep Forge
list.hook: You. You got pockets?
list.ask: Deep forge eats coal like a dragon with a cough. {n} {target}. Don't dawdle.
list.thanks: That'll keep her burning. Good.

list.title: Copper, Quick
list.hook: A word, tall one, while there's a profit in it.
list.ask: Stepcliff wants rails and I'm short. {n} {target} and we'll split it the way I say.
list.thanks: Fair weight. Rare, for a surface walker.

list.title: A Dry Shift
list.hook: This is serious, so listen.
list.ask: The cellar's dry. The CELLAR. Bring {n} {target} so we can brew before the third shift finds out.
list.thanks: You've saved more lives than you'll ever know.

list.title: Invoice for the Elves
list.hook: You're heading somewhere with trees?
list.ask: They owe for forty hinges, and they've owed for sixty years. Hand this to any elf at Lumenhollow. Smile while you do it.
list.thanks: Ah, the hinges. Do tell them we adore their urgency. For your trouble.

list.title: Thinning the Dusk
list.hook: Stay a moment. You move like one who's fought.
list.ask: They gather where the roots run thin. Remove {n} {target}. Quietly, if your kind can manage it.
list.thanks: Adequately done. The Tree noticed.

list.title: Before the Rot Spreads
list.hook: Wait. You've come from the east road, haven't you?
list.ask: They carry the rot on them. Each one that falls buys the forest another season. {n} {target}, if you would.
list.thanks: That is one more season. Thank you, little-lived one.

list.title: Oil for the Lanterns
list.hook: Forgive me. Might you have a moment? Or a year?
list.ask: The lanterns run low and the moths are shy this season. {n} {target} would keep them through to spring.
list.thanks: One more night for each of them. They'd thank you.

list.title: Fresh Cuttings
list.hook: Your boots have been somewhere interesting.
list.ask: I've need of {n} {target}. Cut clean, not pulled. I'll know.
list.thanks: Hm. Mostly cut clean. It will do.

list.title: Thread for the Loom
list.hook: You're wearing that on purpose? Never mind. I've a request.
list.ask: Our silk won't dress everyone. Bring me {n} {target} and I shall see what I can do for your dignity.
list.thanks: A start. Do come back in forty years.

list.title: A Verse for the Hold
list.hook: Would you carry something for me? It's only a verse.
list.ask: A dwarf once asked me how a song ended, a long time ago. It's finished now. Please take it to any dwarf at Anvilgate.
list.thanks: It took them how long? Hah! Fair enough. For your walk.

list.title: The Night Watch
list.hook: You stopped. Could I ask you something, then?
list.ask: They come up the drains at night, and when they do it's our doors that get stoned for it. Kill {n} {target} and I'll make sure Hornsend remembers.
list.thanks: That's the first time anybody's done that for us. Thank you.

list.title: Pepper for the Pot
list.hook: You've got a kind face. Unusual, up here.
list.ask: Nobody on the market will sell to me. If you'd buy {n} {target} and bring them here, the whole Row eats tonight.
list.thanks: Sit, sit. It's safe. Mostly.

list.title: A Cold Quarter
list.hook: I wouldn't normally ask.
list.ask: The city's coal stops at the top of the steps. {n} {target} would see the old ones through the week.
list.thanks: They'll never know who sent it. I will.

list.title: A Name for the Guild
list.hook: Would you carry a letter? It won't bite.
list.ask: It's only a name, for the register. It needs to reach any guard in the city, and they'll throw it away. But it'll have been delivered.
list.thanks: From who? Hornsend? ...Fine. Here. Don't tell anyone.
